notes.title: Speedrun Contest
notes.notes:
[h1]Attention Riders! [/h1]

[b]- From October 5th to 19th you can win one of three Blue Rider's Collectors Edition.[/b]

[b]To participate you must:[/b]
[list]
[*]Record your full playthrough (from start to finish).
[*]Upload the video to Youtube.
[*]Send the link to: bluerider@ravegan.com
[/list]

You can record from PS4, XONE or Steam. No cheating/editing!

Check our [url=https://www.facebook.com/BlueRiderGame/photos/a.1517710705192109.1073741831.1516966531933193/1783374895292354/?type=3]Facebook Page[/url] for more info.

notes.title: Blue Rider Update: Bug Fixing and Performance
notes.notes:
Thanks to the collaboration of the community, we have improved game performance and we have also fixed some bugs.

Bug Fixing:

 - Some achievements are not triggered properly.
 - Textures on level 4.
 
Performance fixes:

 - Shadow quality was improved.
 - Amount of particles used in explosions.
 - Fixed: Lag in several simultaneously explosions
 - New water resolution for medium and low qualities.

notes.title: Blue Rider is officially FINISHED!
notes.notes:
2 days prior to its release on Thursday, March 3rd, we announce that [b]Blue Rider[/b] is finally complete. We've been polishing details and optimizing the performance until the last minute.
We are sure you are going to enjoy (or suffer!) our game A LOT!
Beta Testers keep telling us that the game is "too difficult'... we say "hell yeah!".
We really hope you'll enjoy Blue Rider as much as we did making it. Stay tuned!

- The Ravegan Team

[img]http://www.ravegan.com/bluerider/blue_rider_logo_720x480px.jpg[/img]
